front.title: Quick and Dirty Secure Autonomic Control Plane for GRASP

abstract.t: A secure substrate known as the Autonomic Control Plane (ACP) is required by the Generic Autonomic Signaling Protocol (GRASP) used by Autonomic Service Agents. This document describes QUADS, a QUick And Dirty Secure ACP using symmetric cryptography and preconfigured key material. It also describes a secure mechanism for providing the prefconfigured key material to enrolled ACP nodes via EST.
